policy_extraction.implementation_notes: This is a policy interpretation/reading document accompanying the main implementation opinion on 'AI + Drug Regulation' issued by NMPA. It outlines a 5-10 year roadmap (targets for 2030 and 2035) for integrating AI into drug regulatory processes including review/approval, inspection, risk monitoring, and administrative services. AI is explicitly positioned as auxiliary ('辅助型定位'). Enforcement mechanisms are primarily administrative/supervisory rather than punitive. The document encourages industry digital transformation especially for high-risk categories like blood products and TCM injections.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: The document primarily frames AI governance in drug regulation as an opportunity to modernize and enhance regulatory capabilities through technology integration. The core reasoning is enabling smarter, more efficient regulation rather than mitigating risks from AI itself. Secondary framing includes consumer/public safety through improved drug lifecycle oversight and economic competitiveness via industry digital transformation.
